title: Plynth integrations, version 1
description: Library/integrations.json: the options of the sources in the Integrations tab (core/include/plynth/core/catalog/Integrations.h). Only options the user changed are saved; the others take their defaults. Entries of integrations this Plynth does not know are kept as they are.

blender_window.description: No longer offered and ignored. Older files may hold it; every fetch runs with no window.

formats.description: Model formats in order of preference. Default fbx, gltf, obj, blend.

max_texture_size.description: Pixels. null takes the largest there is. Default 4096.

license.description: A license id of the catalogs, for zips the user imports as Fab by hand. A zip that Plynth guesses is from Fab gets unknown instead. Default royalty_free.
